# Fetch all notes and extract date + good posture status
access_token = login_result["access_token"]
notes_data = []
for note in all_notes:
    note_id = note["note_id"]
    detail = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    title = detail["title"]
    date_str = title.split("for ")[-1].strip()
    content = detail["content"]
    # Find practiced_good_posture line
    posture = None
    for line in content.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("practiced_good_posture:"):
            posture = line.split(":")[-1].strip().lower()
            break
    notes_data.append({"date": date_str, "posture": posture})
    print(f"note {note_id}: date={date_str}, posture={posture}")

steps.code:
# Filter only habit tracking notes and compute longest streak
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Build list of (date, posture) for notes with valid posture
habit_data = []
for d in notes_data:
    if d["posture"] in ("yes", "no"):
        habit_data.append((d["date"], d["posture"] == "yes"))

# Sort by date
habit_data.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
print("Sorted habit data:")
for date, practiced in habit_data:
    print(date, practiced)

# Compute longest consecutive streak of True
max_streak = 0
current_streak = 0
prev_date = None
for date, practiced in habit_data:
    if practiced:
        # Check if consecutive day (or first)
        if prev_date is not None:
            # Parse dates
            curr = datetime.strptime(date, "%Y-%m-%d")
            prev = datetime.strptime(prev_date, "%Y-%m-%d")
            if (curr - prev).days == 1:
                current_streak += 1
            else:
                current_streak = 1
        else:
            current_streak = 1
        max_streak = max(max_streak, current_streak)
    else:
        current_streak = 0
    prev_date = date

print(f"Longest streak: {max_streak}")
